How much does a structured settlement buyout cost?

A structured settlement buyout costs the difference between the value of your future payments and the lump sum you receive. CashNow applies a discount rate of 8.5% to 11% a year, so $100,000 paid over 10 years buys out for about $59,800 to $66,000 today.

Structured settlement buyout cost by discount rate

At an 8.5% discount rate, $100,000 over 10 years is worth about $66,000. At 11% it is worth about $59,800. Every buyout also needs court approval, which takes 45 to 90 days and costs the seller nothing at CashNow.

What affects the price of a buyout?

Three things set the price: the discount rate, how far away the payments are, and whether the payments are guaranteed or life-contingent. Payments due within 5 years buy out at a lower discount than payments due in 20 years.
